Divider

Used to separate content into multiple areas (minimum version: 24.12.0)

Sample Code

Basic Usage


<maui-divider />

Use hairline


<maui-divider hairline />

Dotted Line


<maui-divider dashed />

Text Position


<maui-divider contentPosition='center'>text</maui-divider>
<maui-divider contentPosition='left'>text</maui-divider>
<maui-divider contentPosition='right'>text</maui-divider>

Custom Color


<maui-divider
  contentPosition='center'
  customStyle='color: #1989fa; border-color: #1989fa; font-size: 18px;'
>
  text
</maui-divider>

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
dashed dotted line Boolean false
hairline thin line Boolean false
content-position Text position, Default valueleft, center, right String -
custom-style Custom Style String -

Slot

Name Description
- Custom text content.
